_comment: EXP-1162: THE detail chrome, identical x4 (web lib/detail-chrome.ts, desktop domain::detail_chrome, iOS ExpCore DetailChrome, Android domain/DetailChrome). Points (web px = desktop px = iOS pt = Android dp). TITLE COLLAPSE: the issue face keeps its large title as a ROW of the scrolling content; the header shows the identifier alone until that row has scrolled away, then BREAKS (a threshold, never a progressive morph) into the collapsed title: the mono identifier (small, muted) over the title on ONE truncated line, fading in over `collapseMs` while rising `collapseRise`. `collapsed = !hasTitleRow || titleBottom <= headerBottom` (both in the same coordinate space, the header band's bottom edge incl. the face tabs). A face with no title row of its own (Run, Changes, Results) is ALWAYS collapsed. EDGE STRIPS: content scrolls UNDER the header band and the floating bottom bar. The header band is the page background at `scrim` alpha over a `edgeBlur` blur, no hairline; below it a strip `edgeTop` tall fades both the scrim and the blur to nothing. At the bottom a strip from the screen edge to `edgeBottom` above the bar's top fades the same way upwards. A client that cannot blur what is behind a view (desktop gpui) paints the band OPAQUE, since unblurred text would read through the scrim, and keeps the fades; Android below API 31 falls back to its blur library's scrim.

one point of the title still shows
the title's bottom edge meets the header's: it breaks
